description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect From 15.07.2024 to 21.07.2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it concerns regulatory frameworks and statutory declarations rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
